name: japanese-mt-bench
description: A targeted benchmark for measuring models' Japanese machine translation quality on curated source-target pairs. It evaluates translation accuracy and fluency for Japanese↔other-language directions, allowing comparison of MT systems and LLMs on Japanese-focused translation tasks. Typically used for automatic metric evaluation (e.g., BLEU) and human inspection.
reputation: A niche, task-specific dataset on Hugging Face used for focused Japanese MT evaluation but not a widely adopted community-wide standard.
